definitions.gloss: periodic medical checkup; regular health screening
definitions.explanation: A routine medical examination conducted at regular intervals to monitor health and detect problems early. Includes both general health checkups and specialized screenings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧{定期検診|ていきけんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I get a regular checkup once a year.

examples.japanese: {定期検診|ていきけんしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A cavity was found during a regular checkup.

examples.japanese: {定期検診|ていきけんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to regular checkups, the illness was detected early.

notes:
USAGE:
Applies to various types of regular medical examinations, including general health checkups (⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧), dental checkups (⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧), and cancer screenings (がん⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧). In Japan, companies are legally required to provide annual health checkups for employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期検診|ていきけんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to have a regular checkup)
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定期検診|ていきけんしん} (regular dental checkup)
- {定期検診|ていきけんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (checkup results)

FORMS:
⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ (regular, periodic) + ⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧ (medical examination).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: health checkup (often abbreviated to ⟦{健診|けんしん}→健診：17390_kenshin⟧)
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}ドック→人間ドック：23310_ningendokku⟧: comprehensive physical exam (more thorough)
